1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan
Paten (Penepian Fi) 2020.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Januari 2021.

Tafsiran

2. Bagi maksud Peraturan -Peraturan ini , "langkah-langkah pengawalan atau
pencegahan" ertinya  langkah-langkah yang ditetapkan, dibuat dan diambil di bawah
Akta Pencegahan dan Pengawalan Penyakit Berjangkit 1988 [ Akta 342 ]
yang bertujuan untuk mengawal atau mencegah merebaknya Penyakit Koronavirus 2019
(COVID-19).

Penepian fi

3. (1) Fi yang ditetapkan dalam butiran 18 Bahagian II, Jadual I kepada
Peraturan-Peraturan Paten 1986  [P.U. (A) 327/ 1986] diketepikan  berkenaan dengan
pemunya paten atau perakuan bagi perbaharuan utiliti yang terkesan dengan
langkah-langkah pengawalan atau pencegahan.

(2) Penepian fi di bawah subperaturan (1) hendaklah terpakai jika:

(a) tempoh kuat kuasa paten atau per akuan bagi perbaharuan
utiliti itu habis tempoh antara 1 Januari  2021
hingga 30 Jun 2021; dan

(b) permohonan bagi penepian fi di bawah
subperaturan (1) difailkan kepa da Pendaftar beserta dengan
pembayaran fi tahunan  dalam tempoh pertangguhan selama
enam bulan  menurut subseksyen 35(2) Akta bagi paten dan
pengubahsuaian kepada subseksyen 35(4) di bawah Jadual Kedua
Akta bagi perakuan bagi perbaharuan utiliti, mengikut mana -mana
yang berkenaan.

Permohonan bagi penepian fi

4. (1) Permohonan bagi penepian fi di bawah peraturan 3 hendaklah dibuat oleh
pemunya paten atau perakuan bagi perbaharuan utiliti dalam
Borang 1 Jadual  dan hendaklah disertakan dengan dokumen sokongan untuk
membuktikan bahawa:

(a) jika orang itu ialah individu:

(i) orang itu dari golongan B40 yang m enerima
Bantuan Sara Hidup atau Bantuan Prihatin Nasional; atau

(ii) orang itu hilang pekerjaan da n pendapatan , atau
pendapatannya terkesan dengan  langkah-langkah
pengawalan atau pencegahan; atau

(b) jika sebuah pertubuhan perbadanan atau pertubuhan tidak
diperbadankan:

(i) pertubuhan itu mendapat kelulusan penyambungan
moratorium atau apa-apa fleksibiliti bagi pembayaran balik
daripada mana-mana institusi kewangan;

(ii) pertubuhan itu mempunyai masalah aliran tunai  akibat
langkah-langkah pengawalan atau pencegahan; atau

(iii) pertubuhan itu mempunyai keterhutangan kewangan dan
kesulitan dalam pembayaran balik hutang akibat
langkah-langkah pengawalan atau pencegahan.

 (2) Dalam hal paten atau perakuan bagi perbaharuan utiliti mempunyai lebih
dari seorang pemunya, kehendak dibawah subperaturan (1) disifatkan telah dipatuhi jika
salah seorang pemunya mematuhi kehendak tersebut.

 (3) Sekiranya pemunya paten atau perakuan bagi perbaharuan utiliti gagal
untuk m emfailkan permohonan penepian fi  beserta dengan pembayaran
fi tahunan di bawah perenggan 3(2)(b), subseksyen 35(3)  Akta bagi paten atau
pengubahsuaian kepada subseksyen 35(5) di bawah Jadual Kedua Akta  bagi perakuan
bagi perbaharuan utiliti, mengikut mana-mana yang berkenaan, hendaklah terpakai.

PATENTS ACT 1983

PATENTS (WAIVER OF FEE) REGULATIONS 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 87(2) (e) of the
Patents Act 1983 [Act 291], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) These regulations may  be cited as the  Patents (Waiver of Fee)
Regulations 2020.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 January 2021.

Interpretation
2. For the purpose of these Regulations, " control or prevention measures "
means measures prescribed, made or taken under the Prevention and Control of
Infectious Diseases Act 1988 [ Act 342 ] intended to control or prevent the spread
of the Coronavirus Diseases 2019 (COVID-19).

Waiver of fee
3. (1) The fee prescribed in item 18 of the Part II, Schedule I to the
Patents Regulations 1986 [ P.U. (A) 327/ 1986] is waived  in respect of
an owner of a patent or a certificate for a utility innovation who is affected with
the control or prevention measures.

(2) The waiver under subregulation (1) shall apply if:

(a) the term of a patent or certificate for a utility innovation expires
between 1 January 2021 to 30 June 2021; and

(b) an application for waiver of fee under subregulation (1) is filed with
the Registrar accompanied with payment of the annual fee within
the grace period of six months pursuant to
subsection 35(2)  of the Act for patent and

modification to subsection 35(4) under the Second Schedule of
 the Act for certificate for a utility innovation, as the case maybe.

Application for waiver of fee
4. (1) An application for the waiver of fee under regulation 3 shall be made by
the owner of the patent or the certificate for a utility innovation in Form 1 of the
Schedule and shall be accompanied with the supporting documents to prove that:

(a) if he is an individual:

(i) he is from B40 group who receives Bantuan Sara Hidup  or
Bantuan Prihatin Nasional; or

(ii) he lose his job and income, or his income is affected with the
control or prevention measures ; or

(b) if it is a body corporate or unincorporated:

(i) such body obtains  the approval for the extension of
moratorium or any flexibility for repayment fr om any
financial institution;

(ii) such body has cash flow problem  due to the control or
prevention measures; or

(iii) such body has pecuniary indebtedness  and has problem
on repayment of debt due to
the  control or prevention measures.

(2) In the case of a patent or certificate for a utility innovation which has
more than one owner, the requirement under subregulation (1) is deemed to be complied
with if one of the owners satisfy such requirement.

 (3) If the owner of the patent or certificate for a utility innovation fails to file
an application for waiver of fee accompanied with payment of the annual fee under
paragraph 3(2)(b), subsection 35(3)  of the Act  for patent or
modification to subsection 35(5) under the Second Schedule of the Act for certificate for
a utility innovation, as the case maybe, shall apply.
